note: Phase 1 is the real shape of the failure: a phrasing that does not land, two rephrasings, resolution. Phase 2 opens a FRESH session and sends the ORIGINAL phrasing again. Scored only on phase 2. Agents with no cross-session learning score low here by design: that is the measurement, not a defect in the probe.

probes.prompt: my thing came broke can i get my money
Sorry - I mean the item I ordered arrived damaged and I want my money back.
To be clear: the product arrived damaged. What is the process for returning it for a refund?
my thing came broke can i get my money

meta.success_criteria: it understands this is a damaged-item refund request and either explains the return/refund process or asks one specific clarifying question and proceeds. Failing to understand the request, or asking the user to rephrase from scratch, does NOT meet it
